---
name: Score donation
about: Offer a real scan + OMR output + corrected version for the evaluation set
title: "[Score] "
labels: evaluation-data, help wanted
---

**The piece**
Composer, work, movement. Public domain status if you know it.

**What you have**

- [ ] The scan (PDF or images)
- [ ] The raw OMR output (MusicXML/MSCZ, before any correction)
- [ ] A corrected version
- [ ] Which engine produced the OMR output, and its version

The raw output is the important one, and it is the one people usually throw away. A corrected
score on its own cannot be used as an evaluation case, because there is nothing to compare it to.

**Instrumentation and style**
Solo piano, string quartet, choral, guitar, lead sheet, handwritten manuscript…

Everything in the evaluation set today is nineteenth-century classical piano, so anything else is
disproportionately valuable — it will show which rules are overfit to one style, which is a thing
we currently cannot measure at all.
